notes.name: Course Note
notes.text: The International Development Studies Co-op Placement Preparation Course Part 3 (COPB33) is a mandatory, full-year course for all students to take in the year prior to their placement. Students will automatically be enrolled in this course, but must ensure their timetable is clear for this registration. It is non-credit with no tuition fees attached. NOTE: Students are responsible for ensuring they understand coop course requirements, and that they do not register for other courses during the time the coop course is offered. For any issues regarding the scheduling of this course, please contact the IDS co-op office as soon as possible at 416-287-7113 or ids-coop@utsc.utoronto.ca Exclusion: COPD04H3; COPB31H3 prior to Fall 2021

notes.text: SUPERVISED STUDY/RESEARCH & INDEPENDENT STUDY COURSES In order to qualify for a Supervised Study course, students must locate a professor who will agree to supervise the course, and then follow the steps outlined below. Step 1: Request the course on ACORN. Your status will be interim (INT). You will not be officially enrolled until you complete the remaining steps. Your supervisor will complete their section and forward the form for departmental approval. Step 4: Once the project is approved at the departmental level, the form will be submitted to the Registrar's Office and your status on ACORN will be updated from interim (INT) to approved (APP).

In order to qualify for a Supervised Study course, students must locate a professor who will agree to supervise the course, and then follow the steps outlined below.

Step 1: Request the course on ACORN. Your status will be interim (INT).

Step 4: Once the project is approved at the departmental level, the form will be submitted to the Registrar's Office and your status on ACORN will be updated from interim (INT) to approved (APP).
